codeReview.summary: The fix correctly changes pagination visibility to depend on pagination metadata/URL state instead of visible rows, so empty out-of-range pages still render the recovery controls. The targeted regression test covers the empty-page scenario, and the implementation preserves the URL-driven page/pageSize behavior without regressing the surrounding delivery-log path.

summary: Pass: the empty-page pagination fix addresses the prior failure by keeping the pagination bar visible on out-of-range empty pages and preserving recovery/navigation controls.
